title: BE's PEPPOL "escompte" compensation
summary: Belgian PEPPOL invoices and credit memos keep the payment discount AllowanceCharge so VAT uses the discounted base. They add a compensating AllowanceCharge, an extra TaxSubtotal and ChargeTotalAmount so totals show the full amount as BE practice requires. Analogous changes were made in BaseApp and a test app was added.
key_points: New PeppolBE codeunits for escompte, monetary info and payment info
Discount AllowanceCharge kept; an additional compensating charge restores the displayed totals
PEPPOL Tax Info Provider interface and PEPPOL30 xmlports extended to support the compensation
Analogous changes in the deprecated BaseApp PEPPOL Management code
Test app.json added for PeppolBE tests, which were expanded
